elements: Attacks of Non-element (NE) can be defended by any elements.
Attacks of Fire can be defended by Water.
Attacks of Water can be defended by Fire.
Attacks of Wood can be defended by Stone.
Attacks of Stone can be defended by Wood.
Attacks of Light can not be defended by any elements.
Attacks of Darkness can be defended by any elements,
but the HP becomes 0 if damaged.
If different elements are used together, they become Non-element (NE).
Light can be substituted for Fire, Water, Wood, or Stone element.
curses: Diseases get worse naturally per turn by 5% chance.
Diseases get worse when catched another disease.
When using artifacts to an enemy from Fog, the target is selected at random.
trade: Weapons, Sun Amulet, and Dangerous Mortar can not be discarded.
After the Apocalypse, Discard is replaced into Sacrifice.

notes: When an attack is bounced, it goes to somebody.
Miracles costs MP but can be used repeatedly.
Performed miracles are not subject to Sell, Buy, and Nocturnal Broom.
After the Apocalypse, a devil appears by 25% each time an artifact given.
Earth God uses trade, weapons, armor, and sundries.
Guardians act after enemy's turn by 25% chance.
Guardians leave by 10% chance when damaged.
